title: Digital Content & Social Media Executive
description:
Digital Content & Social Media Executive
£30,000 - £35,000 per annum
Chelmsford, Essex
Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm

Working alongside the Marketing Manager and Marketing Campaign Executive, as well as a network of specialist creative and digital partners, you'll take ownership of the company's social media channels and the content that brings their brand to life - from coming up with the idea, to writing the copy, creating the artwork, shooting the video and seeing how it performs.

My client is looking for someone who can spot a good story, turn a complicated topic into something people want to read or watch, and create content that feels right for the platform it's on.

Duties:
- Own the company social media content from idea through to publication, creating content that is useful, engaging and relevant to each platform, with a particular focus on LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok.
- Come up with ideas, spotting opportunities, trends, stories and conversations that the company can credibly join.
- Write compelling copy that sounds like the business and makes commercial motor insurance easier to understand.
- Create engaging visual content, including graphics, carousels, reels, short-form video and other social-first formats.
- Shoot and edit video, from quick pieces of reactive content through to more considered long-form and campaign content.
- Capture content at the offices, events and shoots, making sure you're getting the most from the people and opportunities around you.
- Plan and manage the social content calendar, ensuring you have a consistent flow of relevant content across the channels.
- Own the social communities, monitoring comments and messages, responding where appropriate and looking for opportunities to grow meaningful engagement.
- Use social analytics to understand what's working, reporting on performance and using those insights to continually improve the content.
- Stay ahead of social trends, formats and platform developments.
- Work with colleagues and subject matter experts across the business to turn their knowledge into content that brokers and policyholders can easily understand and engage with.
- Create and maintain design templates and digital assets to keep our content consistent and recognisable.
- Support the Marketing Manager and wider team with occasional creative, campaign and marketing tasks.

The ideal candidate:
- Previous experience creating content for social platforms, either in an agency, brand, or creator environment.
- You'll have hands-on experience shooting and editing video for both short and long-form formats.
- You'll be comfortable creating artwork and visual assets yourself with a sharp eye for detail.
- You'll be confident using platform analytics, particularly Meta and TikTok and able to turn performance data into useful recommendations for future content.
- Proficiency with tools such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar. Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator & Canva.
- You're curious. You ask questions. You can take a technical subject and find the interesting bit.
- You're a strong copywriter, able to adapt your tone and approach depending on the audience and platform.
- You understand that good social content isn't simply about making something look nice, it needs a reason to exist, a clear audience and an idea behind it.

title: Digital Content & Social Media Executive
description:
Due to their continued success, our client is looking to recruit a creative Digital Content & Social Media Executive to strengthen their thriving marketing department in Chelmsford. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the department on various social media initiatives to promote the business' products and brands.

The successful candidate will combine creativity with a strong understanding of digital marketing, taking ideas from initial concept through to content creation, publication, and performance analysis. They will be confident producing compelling written and visual content, identifying opportunities to engage audiences and adapting their approach to suit different platforms.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Taking ownership of day-to-day social media content, from idea generation and copywriting through to design, filming, editing, and publication
- Developing creative content ideas that support wider marketing objectives and strengthen brand awareness
- Producing a variety of engaging digital assets, including graphics, carousels, short-form videos, and campaign content
- Planning and managing the social media calendar to ensure a consistent flow of relevant, high-quality content
- Working with colleagues across the business to identify stories, insights and expertise that can be translated into engaging digital communications
- Monitoring social media channels, managing audience interactions, and identifying opportunities to increase engagement
- Reviewing platform analytics and reporting on performance, making recommendations to continually improve content and results
- Keeping up to date with emerging social media trends, creative formats, and platform developments
- Creating and maintaining visual assets and templates to ensure brand consistency across digital channels
- Supporting the wider marketing team with creative projects and broader digital marketing initiatives as required

Skills & Experience Required:
- At least two years' experience in social media, digital marketing or content creation, gained within an agency or in-house environment
- Proven experience developing and delivering engaging content across platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok
- Strong copywriting skills, with the ability to adapt tone and messaging for different audiences and channels
- Hands-on experience shooting and editing video content, including short-form video and Reels
- Proficiency in creative tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, CapCut or similar editing software
- Experience managing social media content calendars and maintaining a consistent brand presence across multiple channels.
- An understanding of social media analytics, with the ability to assess performance and use insights to improve future content.
- A creative mindset, strong attention to detail and the confidence to generate ideas and bring them to life.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with colleagues across the business to develop relevant and engaging content

This role would suit a proactive and creative marketing professional who enjoys working across the full content creation process, takes pride in producing high-quality work and is keen to make a tangible contribution to a growing business.

The Day to Day:

- Managing paid digital marketing campaigns across Google, social and native channels. Optimise paid media budgets to maximise enquiries, monitor cost per enquiry to ensure ROI. Recommend budget allocation changes based on performance.

- Collation, organisation and analysis of campaign data and other types of data as required

- Digital Marketing experience
- Experience of Google Analytics
- Experience of using WordPress or similar

- Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills.
- Adaptable and flexible with ability to work on own initiative as well as part of a team

WHAT SKILLS SHOULD I HAVE?
- Have strong written and verbal communication skills
- Be able to work with a variety of people
- Have excellent Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Be highly organised and able to manage priorities effectively

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING?

At Holmes & Hills, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, respectful, and authentic culture. We are a modern and progressive law firm committed to delivering exceptional client service while supporting the wellbeing and professional development of our people.

- A commercial mindset, with the ability to link marketing activity to leads, conversions and business results.

Benefits:
As a digital marketing executive you will get
- The opportunity to join a supportive group with a long history, operating across multiple sectors

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
WE Talent is recruiting for a creative agency that is looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to join its team.

Working across a varied portfolio of clients and sectors, you'll take ownership of SEO and Google Ads, developing and delivering strategies that improve search visibility, drive website traffic and generate measurable results.

You'll work alongside specialists across digital, creative, branding, social media and web, combining analytical skills with creative thinking to deliver effective digital campaigns for clients.

The role

You'll be responsible for developing and implementing digital marketing strategies, with a particular focus on organic and paid search performance. This will include developing SEO strategies covering technical SEO, on-page optimisation and content, as well as creating, managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns.

You'll conduct keyword research and competitor analysis, identify opportunities to improve search performance, and plan, write and optimise blogs, website content and landing pages. You'll also manage client websites through WordPress and use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager to monitor performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

You'll track leads, conversions, acquisition costs and return on marketing spend, translating client objectives into practical strategies and campaign plans. You'll prepare performance reports, communicate recommendations clearly to clients and collaborate with colleagues across social media, creative, brand and web to deliver joined-up campaigns. Using AI tools effectively for research, analysis, content creation and everyday digital marketing tasks will also be an important part of the role.

About you

We're looking for an experienced digital marketing professional with at least three years' experience, ideally within an agency or a similarly varied environment. You'll have strong, demonstrable experience in SEO and Google Ads, alongside practical WordPress experience and the ability to write and optimise website content and blogs.

You'll have a good working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager, together with strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into practical insights and recommendations. You'll understand lead generation, conversions, cost per acquisition (CPA) and return on advertising spend (ROAS/ROMS), and be confident managing multiple client accounts and priorities.

You'll also be comfortable working directly with clients, explaining your recommendations and demonstrating the results of campaigns you've personally delivered. Experience using AI tools within digital marketing workflows is essential.

Additional experience

Experience with Meta Ads, other paid social platforms, organic social media, email marketing, CRM and marketing automation would be beneficial. Knowledge of AI and generative search, LinkedIn advertising, lead generation and conversion rate optimisation would a lso be useful.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
MARKETING MANAGER WICKFORD, ESSEX BASIC SALARY CIRCA £50k

What's the deal

At a time when many in the market are standing still, this family-run manufacturer is powering ahead. Turnover has more than doubled since we started working with them, driven by new products, five own brands and major investment across internal sales, field sales, and marketing.

Despite that growth, the business has kept everything that makes it special: exceptional people, down-to-earth leadership, quick decisions, and genuine trust. Now it needs a Marketing Manager to build on that momentum, raise the profile of its brands and play a key role in an exciting next chapter.

Your mission
- This is a hands-on role with room to think big. You'll set the direction, roll up your sleeves, and make sure great Ideas actually leave the whiteboard.
- Build and own a marketing plan that turns growth goals into campaigns people notice-and act on.
- Get close to customers, competitors, and market trends, turning insights into sharper positioning.
- Bring the brand to life across the website, social media, email, content, advertising, brochures, and sales tools.
- Plan and deliver launches, promotions, exhibitions, and trade campaigns from bright idea to brilliant execution.
- Work with sales, product teams, leaders, agencies, and suppliers so marketing is joined-up, useful and timely.
- Own the marketing calendar and budget, choosing the right channels instead of doing what's always been done.
- Track numbers, leads, engagement, conversion, revenue, and ROI-and use them to improve the next campaign.

The kind of person we're looking for
- Marketing Manager experience, ideally in B2 B, manufacturing, high volume construction products.
- Equal parts strategist and doer: shaping plans, writing briefs, and stepping in when deadlines need rescuing.
- A confident communicator who inspires enthusiasm and keeps everyone moving together.
- Creative, commercially minded, and curious about what makes customers tick.
- Comfortable with digital tools, campaign data, and budgets-you don't need to love spreadsheets but must understand them.
- Organised, proactive and low ego; comfortable with autonomy, collaboration and making a visible difference.

The Package
- Circa £50k basic
- 25 days' holiday + bank holidays
- Real autonomy, supportive leadership, and a role with genuine influence

Sound like your kind of move?

If you can turn a blank page into a campaign, a spreadsheet into a decision and 'we should probably market that' into something customers notice, we'd love to hear from you. This is your chance to shape the marketing function, make your mark and have some fun doing it.

title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Social Specialist to join a growing marketing function and take ownership of paid social activity across the group.

This role would suit someone who understands how to turn business objectives into effective paid campaigns that generate leads and drive conversions, rather than simply managing social media content. You will be responsible for planning, launching, optimising and reporting on paid social campaigns, with a particular emphasis on Meta advertising alongside LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

This is a varied role combining creative thinking with analytical insight, giving you the opportunity to test new ideas, improve campaign performance and make a direct impact on business growth. There is also uncapped commission linked to lead generation and conversions.

Responsibilities:
As a Paid Social Specialist you will
- Plan, manage and optimise paid social campaigns, with a strong focus on Meta.
- Develop audience targeting strategies to generate leads and drive conversions.
- Manage campaign budgets and optimise spend to maximise performance and return on investment.
- Test and refine audiences, creative, messaging and placements to improve results.
- Collaborate with the wider marketing team to develop engaging ad copy and creative.
- Monitor and analyse key metrics, including cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
- Set up conversion tracking and produce performance reports with recommendations for improvement.
- Work with internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and target audiences.
- Keep up to date with paid media trends and identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.

Requirements:
As a Paid Social Specialist, you will need
- Proven experience managing paid social campaigns, with strong hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager.
- A good understanding of campaign targeting, optimisation and performance measurement.
- Experience managing paid media budgets and making data-led decisions.
- The ability to analyse campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.
- Experience with A/B testing, audience segmentation and retargeting.
- An understanding of conversion tracking, lead generation and campaign analytics.
- Strong creative awareness, with an understanding of what makes paid advertising engaging and effective.
- A commercial mindset, with the ability to link marketing activity to leads, conversions and business results.
- The confidence to take ownership of campaigns while working collaboratively as part of a team.

Benefits:
As a Paid Social Specialist you will get
- The opportunity to join a supportive group with a long history, operating across multiple sectors
- Uncapped commission linked to lead generation and conversions.
- Staff discount
- Career development opportunities.
- The opportunity to combine creative campaign development with data analysis and see the direct impact of your work on business performance.

If you're an experienced Paid Social Specialist looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales, Marketing & Data Analyst
description:
Sales, Marketing & Data Analyst

We're working on a retained basis with an established business in Colchester to find a Sales, Marketing & Data Analyst. Part of a wider European group, they're bringing several acquired businesses together and investing in the systems behind them. This is a brand new role reporting directly into senior management.

The Role

You'd be the central data and insight role for the marketing, commercial and senior leadership teams, guiding decisions on pricing, sales, campaigns and strategy across UK regions, customer demographics and product lines. There's a wealth of data in the business, with more arriving from acquisitions into a single CRM hub, and nobody currently turning it into insight.

The split is roughly 40% hands-on with the data and 60% working with the commercial team. You'll track the KPIs, build forecasting models, measure campaign performance and customer journeys, and build dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio, as well as helping shape the new CRM hub alongside the IT lead.

This isn't a reporting role. They need someone who goes looking, spots the opportunity nobody asked about, and persuades a room full of commercial people to act on it. As a brand new position, it will take shape as you settle in, so a flexible, proactive approach matters as much as the technical skill.

What We're Looking For
- 1 to 5 years in a commercial, sales or marketing analytics role, ideally B2 B, e-commerce, consumer services or agency
- A track record of analysis that changed decisions, not just reported on them
- Advanced Excel, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP and data modelling
- Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio, plus familiarity with GA4 and CRM data such as Salesforce or Dynamics 365
- Forecasting and campaign measurement experience is a strong advantage
- An excellent communicator, persuasive and collaborative, curious and self-motivated
- A full UK driving licence and your own transport, as the office is not easily reached by public transport
- Happy to be office-based while you bed in, with hybrid working considered after an initial period

What They Offer

It's a good moment to join. The business is acquiring, investing and building a UK operation designed to grow, with the backing of an established European group, and you'd be reporting straight into senior management with visibility from day one.

The holiday is excellent too: a generous 7 weeks paid a year, including bank holidays. It follows a set annual calendar, taken as one week at Easter, four weeks in August and two weeks at Christmas.

Due to the location of the offices, this position will suit those commuting from areas such as Colchester, Ipswich, Sudbury, Halstead, Braintree, Witham, Chelmsford, Manningtree, Clacton-on-Sea, Maldon and Bury St Edmunds.
